questions.question: Which Indian state was the first to introduce a formal Sabbatical Leave scheme?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Sikkim**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Sikkim becomes 1st state to launch Sabbatical Leave scheme for govt staff.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Sikkim** became the **first state in India** to introduce a **formal Sabbatical Leave scheme** (launched in **August 2023**).

 
 
• 
 
The scheme allows **regular government employees** with **at least 5 years of continuous service** to take **365 to 1,080 days of leave**, receiving **50% of basic pay** during the leave period.

 
 
• 
 
**Seniority is preserved**, and employees may be **recalled with one month’s notice**.

 
 
• 
 
The scheme was later **extended to temporary employees** with **6 months of service**, under the **same benefits**.

 
 
• 
 
In **April 2025**, approval powers were **delegated**:

 
 
• 
 
**Group C & D staff (including temporary)**: Leave can be granted by **Heads of Departments**.

 
 
• 
 
**Group A & B staff**: Must seek approval from the **Secretary of the Personnel Department**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
Many **youths used the leave to pursue personal goals and launch startups**.

questions.question: Where was India's first full-scale Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Pilot Line Facility inaugurated?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanand, Gujarat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The OSAT Pilot Line Facility was inaugurated in Sanand, Gujarat, marking a significant milestone in India’s semiconductor roadmap.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Ashwini Vaishnaw** and **Bhupendra Patel** inaugurated India’s first **full-scale Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Pilot Line** in **Sanand, Gujarat**, developed by **CG Semi**.

 
 
• 
 
The facility is a key milestone under the **India Semiconductor Mission (ISM)**, which aims to enhance India's semiconductor manufacturing and technological sovereignty.

 
 
• 
 
The **OSAT Pilot Line** supports chip assembly, packaging, testing, and post-test services, positioning India as a global semiconductor player.

 
 
• 
 
**CG Semi’s investment** of ₹7,600 crore (USD 870 million) includes two plants, generating **5,000 jobs** and setting India on a path to self-reliance in semiconductor production.

 
 
• 
 
**Strategic collaboration** between **CG Power, Renesas Electronics**, and **Stars Microelectronics** brings global expertise, with **Indian engineers** undergoing advanced training for high-tech operations.

questions.question: Which regulatory authority released the Ayurveda Aahara list?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**FSSAI**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• FSSAI Releases Official List of Recognised Ayurveda Aahara Items.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**FSSAI**, with the **Ministry of Ayush**, issued a list of **Ayurveda Aahara** items.

 
 
• 
 
It follows the **Ayurveda Aahara Regulations, 2022**.

 
 
• 
 
The list is based on **classical Ayurvedic texts** from **Schedule A**.

 
 
• 
 
Released under **Note (1) of Schedule B** of the 2022 regulations.

 
 
• 
 
It ensures **authenticity** and promotes **consumer confidence**.

 
 
• 
 
Aims to guide **Food Business Operators (FBOs)** in Ayurvedic food production.

 
 
• 
 
Encourages **mainstream adoption** of India’s **traditional food wisdom**.

 
 
• 
 
Ayurveda Aahara supports **digestion, immunity**, and **overall well-being**.

 
 
• 
 
The move ensures **regulatory clarity** for stakeholders and boosts **public health**.

questions.question: Pariksha Pe Charcha has set a Guinness World Record with 3.53 crore registrations. When was Pariksha Pe Charcha first launched?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**2018**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Pariksha Pe Charcha Sets Guinness Record with 3.53 Cr Registrations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Pariksha Pe Charcha (PPC)** 2025 set a **Guinness World Record** for the **most people registered on a citizen engagement platform in one month**.

 
 
• 
 
Over **3.53 crore registrations** were made via the **MyGov** platform.

 
 
• 
 
**PPC** is an **annual event** where **PM Narendra Modi** interacts with **students, teachers, and parents** ahead of board exams.

 
 
• 
 
Launched in **2018**, the event has grown in scale and participation each year.

 
 
• 
 
Organised by the **Ministry of Education** in collaboration with **MyGov**.

 
 
• 
 
PPC is part of the broader **Exam Warriors** movement initiated by PM Modi.

 
 
• 
 
The goal is to **reduce exam stress** and promote a **holistic educational approach**.

questions.question: Where will the 17th Edition of BioFach India be held?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Greater Noida.**__

__
 
• **The 17th Edition of BioFach India will be held at the India Expo Centre and Mart in Greater Noida.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 17th Edition of BioFach India will take place at the India Expo Centre and Mart in Greater Noida.**
 
• **Over 27 Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) from the North-Eastern Region will showcase products under the Mission Organic Value Chain Development.**

• BioFach India__

 __
 
• Is an event dedicated to organic products, bringing together global stakeholders in the organic sector.
 
 
 
• Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)__
 __
 
• Organizations of farmers that collectively market their products and promote their welfare.
 
 
 
• Mission Organic Value Chain Development__
 
 
• A program aimed at promoting organic farming and connecting farmers to global markets.

questions.question: Who inaugurated the SheLeads II programme in New Delhi?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Annpurna Devi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Annpurna Devi Inaugurates SheLeads II to Boost Women’s Leadership.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Union Minister Annpurna Devi** inaugurated **SheLeads II** in **New Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
The event is a **two-day workshop** by the **UN Women India Country Office**.

 
 
• 
 
SheLeads is UN Women’s **flagship capacity-building programme**.

 
 
• 
 
It aims to promote **gender equality in political and public leadership**.

 
 
• 
 
The event follows the **Women’s Reservation Act, 2023**, mandating **33% reservation** for women in **Lok Sabha** and **State Assemblies**.

 
 
• 
 
The programme supports women to contest in upcoming **Lok Sabha and Assembly elections**.

 
 
• 
 
SheLeads equips women with **skills, networks, and confidence** to lead.

 
 
• 
 
It brings together **grassroots women leaders**, **elected representatives**, and **administrators**.

 
 
• 
 
Focuses on fostering **dialogue**, building **leadership capacity**, and increasing **women’s participation in governance**.

questions.question: What is the name of the bridge in Bihar that has become Asia's widest extradosed bridge?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Aunta-Simaria Ganga Bridge.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Aunta-Simaria Ganga Bridge in Bihar is Asia's widest extradosed bridge.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The bridge has a 34-meter-wide deck and spans over the River Ganga, strategically located between Aunta and Simaria.**
 
• The project integrates North and South Bihar, reducing travel time by over an hour and significantly improving regional connectivity.
 
• It is a six-lane bridge that will provide a direct connection between Patna and Begusarai, reducing travel time significantly.
 
• The Aunta-Simaria Ganga Bridge is designed to handle heavy traffic, making it a key infrastructure project in the region.
 
• The bridge also aims to improve connectivity to key areas like Simaria Dham, a pilgrimage site in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Extradosed Bridge__

 __
 
• A type of bridge combining aspects of both cable-stayed and cantilevered bridges
 
• Characterized by a hybrid structure that provides both efficiency and aesthetic appeal
 
 
 
• Ganga River__
 __
 
• One of the major rivers in India, running through multiple states including Bihar
 
• The bridge spans the Ganga River, improving connectivity between North and South Bihar
 
 
 
• Simaria Dham__
 
 
• A renowned pilgrimage site located in the region, benefiting from improved accessibility via the bridge
